parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button located on the top of the toilet tank, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism when pressed, releasing water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A hinged cover that sits on top of the toilet seat, made of molded plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the toilet bowl to maintain hygiene and reduce odor when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge to open and close over the seat.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A flush button located on the tank lid, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It triggers the flushing system to clean the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves downward when pressed and returns upward after release.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main structural body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user, holds water, and channels waste to the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that provides structural stability.
